q: These minor restrictions are due to the fact that all Lojban cmene embedded in a speech stream will be preceded by one of these words or by a pause. With one of these words embedded, the cmene might break up into valid Lojban words followed by a shorter cmene.
1997, John W. Cowan, The Complete Lojban Language, →ISBN:
cmene always end with a consonant followed by a mandatory pause (a period). No other Lojban word ends with a consonant.
